parameters.content:
# Collect BBB business listings into Google Sheets with Apify

Maintain a business-research table from Better Business Bureau searches without manually copying listings into a spreadsheet. This workflow is useful for local-market research, competitor comparisons, and reviewing business profiles by keyword and location.

It runs [FalconScrape's BBB Advanced Scraper](https://apify.com/piotrv1001/bbb-advanced-scraper) through your Apify account, waits for the run to finish, and imports the results into Google Sheets. Businesses are matched by their BBB profile URL, so repeated observations update existing rows. The table retains first-seen dates and provides space for your own notes. A separate run log records the source run and lets you retry an import without purchasing another scrape.

## Setup

Install the official Apify integration, connect your Apify API and Google Sheets OAuth2 credentials, and create a destination spreadsheet. Enter its ID, search term, location, distance, and maximum Actor charge in **Configure search**. Start manually; the workflow creates its two output tabs automatically.

The template is free; Apify Actor runs and your n8n service may incur charges. We maintain the paid FalconScrape Actor used here. Results are bounded observations, not an exhaustive directory. Empty or failed extractions stop for review.

Tested on self-hosted n8n 2.38.5 with the Apify integration 0.7.0. See the setup guide for costs, recovery, and scheduling considerations.


### Recovery
If execution fails, inspect the saved run before retrying. Set **resumeRunId** to reuse its dataset. Remove a stale lock only after confirming no execution is active. Keep user notes in column Q onward.

### 1 · Prepare the destination
Validate settings and managed columns. Create missing tabs and acquire an atomic sheet-title lock before paid work. Keep scraped columns unchanged; use column Q onward for your own notes.

### 2 · Start or recover
New runs have a dollar cap and a 180-second timeout. Recovery loads the supplied run ID. Never automatically retry the paid start request. The run checkpoint records the original input and run ID before polling.

### 3 · Validate and write
Reject empty or oversized datasets. Deduplicate by BBB profile URL, preserve newer observations and first-seen dates, and write literal values. Commit the run log with business updates, then release the destination lock.

### If a node fails
Open its error and the BBB Runs tab. Check whether the Actor is still running. Once no execution is active, delete only **_BBB_WORKFLOW_LOCK**, set **resumeRunId**, and run again. Never delete business/run tabs to fix an error.
